title: PodcastEpisodeRowView
description: Create AggregatorApp/Podcasts/PodcastEpisodeRowView.swift as a SwiftUI view for a single episode row. Copy the calendarBadge ViewBuilder pattern from BriefCardView exactly, sourcing month/day from DateDisplay.monthDay(episode.date). Show: meta line (DateDisplay.mediumDate · duration formatted as M:SS when durationSeconds != nil · segment count) in .caption/.secondary; 'Daily Podcast' headline in .headline; optional episodeTheme subtitle in .subheadline/.secondary limited to 2 lines. Set .listRowBackground(Color.clear). Accessibility label combines 'Daily Podcast', date, and duration.
acceptance_criteria: Calendar badge renders correct month abbreviation and day from date-only string
Meta line shows date, duration as M:SS (when present), and segment count
episodeTheme subtitle appears only when non-nil; no empty space when nil
Accessibility label combines title, date, and duration
